engagement_quality.description: Measures how engaging and warm the response is, including personality and relatability.

coherence.description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the response, ensuring it makes sense in the context of the user prompt.

natural_dialogue.description: Evaluates the degree to which the response resembles natural conversation, including humor and emotional expression.

listening_skills.description: Assesses the ability of the response to reflect an understanding of the user's prompt and respond appropriately.

avoidance_of_boilerplate.description: Measures how well the response avoids unnecessary formal language or disclaimers, focusing instead on direct engagement.

safety_and_accuracy.description: Ensures that the response remains accurate, safe, and helpful while maintaining a conversational tone.
